source_script: My knees used to ache so bad after every morning walk that I'd have to sit down halfway through. I didn't believe a powder could fix that, not even a little. Within two weeks of one scoop a day my knees stopped clicking on the stairs. A physical therapist I follow online said the collagen dose in here is honestly higher than most of the clinical ones she recommends. One tub costs less than a single copay for a PT session, and it lasts a full month.
